title: Correction: suggest a similar column name when referenced column is missing
description: When a step references a column that does not exist in the dataset, the corrector should suggest the most similar column name from the available columns. Similarity can be measured by string distance (e.g. 'revnue' → 'revenue') or semantic similarity (e.g. 'turnover' → 'sales'). Present the suggested replacement to the user before re-executing the workflow.
planner_guidance: If the user's query references a concept that does not exactly match a column name, look at the dataset's available columns and use the closest match. For example, if the user says 'revenue' but the dataset has 'sales', use 'sales' in the workflow and note the substitution.

example.message: Column 'revnue' not found. Did you mean 'revenue'? Use the actual column name in the workflow.

rag_note: RAG context provides this correction guidance to help the planner avoid generating workflows with invalid column references. The validator will still reject invalid columns; this guidance helps the planner self-correct before validation.
